item.title: PodCow Daily News Edmonton: Thursday, September 17, 2026
item.description: Edmonton marks a high-intensity transition today as new head coach Mike Babcock launches rigorous Oilers training camp practices while Prairie farmers grapple with widespread harvest delays. On the international stage, Prime Minister Mark Carney welcomed an unprecedented EU proposal for Canadian associate membership, even as UN experts released a report alleging U.S. war crimes in Iran.
